prior_information: Reviewer saw aggregate v5 outcomes. Step labels and candidate scores were omitted from contact sheets. v6 scores were not consulted to author these notes.
sampling: All 32 aligned 8-Hz samples in each source/reconstruction pair; RX decoded slots also inspected. Intervals are half-open frame indices.
object_contract: Recognizable scene entities. Texture changes, grass blades, shadows and deformed parts of an existing entity are not automatically new entities. Fine distant entities and ambiguous double exposures remain uncertain.
numeric_truth_policy: Only unambiguous absence of new entities yields whole-clip UEP=0. No exact FSO or EOI scalar is inferred from coarse visual event descriptions. Unavailable and uncertain values remain null.
